title: Hacker News
description: Read-only tools for browsing Hacker News: extract front-page stories and search via the on-page Algolia search box.

tools.name: hn_list_stories
tools.description: List the story titles currently visible on this Hacker News page (front page, new, best, etc.).

tools.name: hn_search
tools.description: Search Hacker News stories and comments. Submits the on-page Algolia search box, which navigates to hn.algolia.com results.
